|game_text=Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. May steal (and then use) an opponent's lightsaber just lost from same site; may then use two weapons. While [[The Quick And Easy Path]] on table, [[Jedi Escape]] and [[What Was It?]] may not cancel duels. Immune to attrition < 5.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Lord Vader (V)]]; it is the current text. No published card image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB3-13E-Lord_Vader-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB3-D-lordvader-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB3-13E-Lord_Vader.png]]) show the original text (see [[Lord Vader (V)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Lord Vader (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 3 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009; slip 13E)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf Virtual Block 3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174313/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “[Pilot] 3. May deploy an opponent's lightsaber just lost from same site on him (for free); may then use two weapons. While The Quick And Easy Path on table, Jedi Escape and What Was It? may not cancel duels. Immune to attrition < 5.” The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) showed the same text (marked “Errata Text - September 9th, 2009”).<ref name="cl-1230_13-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock3Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064716/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The game text above writes the pilot icon “3” out as “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots”.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) changed “May deploy an opponent's lightsaber just lost from same site on him (for free)” to “May steal (and then use) an opponent's lightsaber just lost from same site” (slip marked E): “[Pilot] 3. May steal (and then use) an opponent's lightsaber just lost from same site; may then use two weapons. While The Quick And Easy Path on table, Jedi Escape and What Was It? may not cancel duels. Immune to attrition < 5.”<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
